en.t: The handwriting was elegant and stylish.

units.source_text: 于是把右近叫来，对她言道：“凡遇写此种情书的人，务须仔细探究其人来历，好好地答复。

en.t: So he called Ukon over and said to her, "Whenever someone writes this sort of love letter, you must carefully look into his background and give him a proper reply.

units.source_text: 好色爱玩的时髦小伙子为非作恶，不能完全归咎于男子。

en.t: When fashionable young men who love flirtation and amusement behave badly, the blame cannot be placed entirely on the man.

units.source_text: 据我亲身经历看来，女子不答复男子，男子痛恨她冷酷无情，此时难免做出违心之事。

en.t: Judging from my own experience, if a woman does not answer a man, he may bitterly resent her as cold and heartless, and then he is liable to do things against his better judgment.

units.source_text: 女子若是身份低微之人，而不理睬男子，男子便怪她无礼，亦不免做出非礼之行。

en.t: If the woman is of low rank and ignores the man, he will accuse her of rudeness and may well behave improperly toward her.

units.source_text: 男子若是并无深情，来信只是吟花咏蝶，而女子也用风雅态度对付他，则反而煽动了他的热情。

en.t: If the man has no deep feeling and his letters merely sing of flowers and butterflies, then if the woman responds in the same elegant manner, she will only inflame his passion.

units.source_text: 此时可以不睬，就此绝交，女子亦不任其咎。

en.t: In such a case she may ignore him and break things off at once, and no blame will fall on her.

units.source_text: 倘男子只是逢场作戏，偶尔寄书，则女子切不可立刻作复，否则后患无穷。

en.t: If the man is only amusing himself and happens to send a letter on a whim, the woman must never answer at once, or there will be endless trouble later.

units.source_text: 总之，凡女子不知谨慎，任心而动，自以为知情识趣，所有兴会都不放过，其结果必然不佳。

en.t: In short, when a woman lacks caution, acts as her heart pleases, thinks herself clever and understanding, and lets no opportunity for diversion pass by, the result is bound to be bad.

units.source_text: 但兵部卿亲王与髭黑大将，谦恭有礼，决非胡言乱道之人。

en.t: But Prince Hyobukyo and the General Higekuro are humble and courteous, and they are certainly not men who speak recklessly or foolishly.

units.source_text: 倘不辨是非，置之不理，便有失体统。

en.t: If you fail to distinguish right from wrong and simply ignore them, it would be improper.

units.source_text: 至于比他们身份低微的人，则可依照其志趣，辨别其情感，观察其诚意之深浅，而作适当之应付。”

en.t: As for men of lower rank than they, you may respond appropriately by considering their aims and tastes, discerning their feelings, and judging the depth of their sincerity."
